chapterInfo.content:
4
Ahome a Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ ho bɔ no
1Saa nti, ɛnam sɛ wɔagya yɛn ne home mu kɔ ho bɔhyɛ nti, momma yɛnsuro, na mo mu biara anyɛ sɛ waka akyi. 2Na wɔaka asɛmpa nso akyerɛ yɛn sɛ wɔn ara; nanso wɔannya asɛm a wɔteeɛ no ho mfasoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɛne gyidie no annkɔ bɛn korɔ mu, wɔn a wɔteeɛ no mu. 3#Dwom 95.11; Heb 3.11 Na yɛn a yɛagye adie no kɔ ɔhome no mu, sɛdeɛ ɔkaa sɛ:
Mekaa ntam m’abufuo mu sɛ:
Wɔrenhyɛne me home mu.
Nanso wɔfiri wiase fapemtoɔ awie nnwuma no dada. 4#Gye 2.2 Na baabi waka ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no ho asɛm sɛ: Na Onyankopɔn homee da a ɛtɔ so nson firi ne nnwuma nyinaa mu. 5Na ɛhanom ɔka bio sɛ: Wɔrenhyɛne me home mu.
6Enti, sɛ aka sɛ ebinom bɛkɔ mu, na asoɔden nti wɔn a wɔkaa wɔn asɛmpa no kane no ankɔ mu nti, 7#Dwom 95.7-8; Heb 3.7 ɔhyɛɛ da bi bio nam Dawid so kaa sɛ: “Ɛnnɛ”, ɛkyɛree saa no, ɔkaa sɛdeɛ yɛabɔ din dada no sɛ:
Ɛnnɛ, sɛ mote ne nne a,
mommpirim mo akoma!
8 # Deut 31.7; Yos 22.4 Na sɛ na Yosua ama wɔn ahome a, anka akyire yi wammɔ da foforɔ din bio.
9Ɛnneɛ na homedadie da so ara wɔ hɔ ma Nyankopɔn man. 10#Adi 14.13 Na deɛ wahyɛne ne home mu no, ɔno nso home firii ne nnwuma ho, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn home firii ne deɛ ho no.
11Enti momma yɛmmɔ mmɔden nhyɛne ɔhome no mu, na obi anhwe ase anyɛ asoɔden korɔ no ara ho nhwɛsoɔ. 12#Yer 23.29 Na Nyankopɔn asɛm wɔ nkwa, na ahoɔden wɔ mu, na ano yɛ nnam sene nkrantɛ anofanu biara, na ɛhwire mu kɔduru sɛ ɛpaepae ɔkra ne honhom, akwaa ne ekyim mu, na ɛyɛ akoma nsusuiɛ ne adwene temmufoɔ.
13Na abɔdeɛ biara nni hɔ a ɛnna adie Nyankopɔn anim, na ade nyinaa ho da hɔ, na ɛso abue, deɛ yɛne no wɔ asɛm no anim.
Yɛn sɔfo panin Yesu
14 # Heb 3.1; 6.20; 7.26; 8.1; 9.11 Enti, sɛ yɛwɔ ɔsɔfo panin kɛseɛ a watwa mu ɔsoro, a ɔno ne Yesu, Nyankopɔn Ba no yi, momma yɛnsɔ yɛn gyidie asɛm a yɛgyina so ka no mu dendeenden. 15#Heb 2.17 Na yɛnni ɔsɔfo panin a ɔnnim yɛn mmerɛyɛ na ɔnni tema mma yɛn, na mmom deɛ wɔasɔ no ahwɛ adeɛ nyinaa mu sɛ yɛn ara, nso wannyɛ bɔne. 16#1 Yoh 3.21; Rom 3.25 Enti momma yɛmfa nnam mmra adom ahennwa no anim, na yɛanya mmɔborɔhunu, na yɛahunu adom, na ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ mu aboa yɛn.

pageProps.chapterText:
Saa nti, ɛnam sɛ wɔagya yɛn ne home mu kɔ ho bɔhyɛ nti, momma yɛnsuro, na mo mu biara anyɛ sɛ waka akyi. Na wɔaka asɛmpa nso akyerɛ yɛn sɛ wɔn ara; nanso wɔannya asɛm a wɔteeɛ no ho mfasoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɛne gyidie no annkɔ bɛn korɔ mu, wɔn a wɔteeɛ no mu. Na yɛn a yɛagye adie no kɔ ɔhome no mu, sɛdeɛ ɔkaa sɛ:
Mekaa ntam m’abufuo mu sɛ:
Wɔrenhyɛne me home mu.
Nanso wɔfiri wiase fapemtoɔ awie nnwuma no dada. Na baabi waka ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no ho asɛm sɛ: Na Onyankopɔn homee da a ɛtɔ so nson firi ne nnwuma nyinaa mu. Na ɛhanom ɔka bio sɛ: Wɔrenhyɛne me home mu.
Enti, sɛ aka sɛ ebinom bɛkɔ mu, na asoɔden nti wɔn a wɔkaa wɔn asɛmpa no kane no ankɔ mu nti, ɔhyɛɛ da bi bio nam Dawid so kaa sɛ: “Ɛnnɛ”, ɛkyɛree saa no, ɔkaa sɛdeɛ yɛabɔ din dada no sɛ:
Ɛnnɛ, sɛ mote ne nne a,
mommpirim mo akoma!
Na sɛ na Yosua ama wɔn ahome a, anka akyire yi wammɔ da foforɔ din bio.
Ɛnneɛ na homedadie da so ara wɔ hɔ ma Nyankopɔn man. Na deɛ wahyɛne ne home mu no, ɔno nso home firii ne nnwuma ho, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn home firii ne deɛ ho no.
Enti momma yɛmmɔ mmɔden nhyɛne ɔhome no mu, na obi anhwe ase anyɛ asoɔden korɔ no ara ho nhwɛsoɔ. Na Nyankopɔn asɛm wɔ nkwa, na ahoɔden wɔ mu, na ano yɛ nnam sene nkrantɛ anofanu biara, na ɛhwire mu kɔduru sɛ ɛpaepae ɔkra ne honhom, akwaa ne ekyim mu, na ɛyɛ akoma nsusuiɛ ne adwene temmufoɔ.
Na abɔdeɛ biara nni hɔ a ɛnna adie Nyankopɔn anim, na ade nyinaa ho da hɔ, na ɛso abue, deɛ yɛne no wɔ asɛm no anim.

Enti, sɛ yɛwɔ ɔsɔfo panin kɛseɛ a watwa mu ɔsoro, a ɔno ne Yesu, Nyankopɔn Ba no yi, momma yɛnsɔ yɛn gyidie asɛm a yɛgyina so ka no mu dendeenden. Na yɛnni ɔsɔfo panin a ɔnnim yɛn mmerɛyɛ na ɔnni tema mma yɛn, na mmom deɛ wɔasɔ no ahwɛ adeɛ nyinaa mu sɛ yɛn ara, nso wannyɛ bɔne. Enti momma yɛmfa nnam mmra adom ahennwa no anim, na yɛanya mmɔborɔhunu, na yɛahunu adom, na ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ mu aboa yɛn.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
